name: hcportal_updateKennelRequest
description: A reviewer corrects an open (RequestStatus 0/1) kennel request before approving it (E12.F1.S5; website-read fields added 2026-10-10 for E12.F1.S10): requester details, kennel names and links, prices, location (country/region/city ids from our own tables), logo, founding date, run day/time, runs page and social links. NULL keeps a field; '' clears an optional one. User text arrives as NVARCHAR(MAX) and is LEN-checked against the column widths, so nothing is truncated silently. Region/city must agree with country/region; a country or region change clears what sits below it, and the Country/Region/City text columns are refreshed from the ids. The row is locked WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) for the edit. Replaces the UPDATE branch of the HC3W INSTEAD OF trigger. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; caller must hold a live HC.PlatformAdmin row with CanEditKennel = 1.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Portal token; standard param string (device secret).

parameters.name: kennelImportId
parameters.description: The request to edit. Required — no SQL default; must be open (RequestStatus 0 awaiting email or 1 new).

parameters.name: kennelShortName
parameters.description: ≤20, letters and digits only — becomes the web address

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always one row. Success = 0 on auth failure, missing CanEditKennel, any validation message (lengths, email shape, short name letters/digits only, https logo, founded date, run day 1-7, HH:mm, HC6.SocialLinksProblem, region/city consistency), 'Request not found' / 'Only an open request can be edited' (after ROLLBACK), or from the CATCH block (ROLLBACK, HC.ErrorLog row, ERROR_MESSAGE()).

sideEffects: UPDATE EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport (the given fields, location ids with dependent clears, updatedAt), then the Country/Region/City text columns from the ids — one transaction
On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog after the ROLLBACK

codeSmells.detail: Line 4: @kennelImportId has no default. A client that omits it gets SQL's 'expects parameter' refusal (an unlogged empty 500); the SP's own 'kennelImportId is required' check on line 100 is unreachable for an omitted parameter.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
